gap: Exact flight duration for each package not stated on main pages (approximate times found in what-to-expect)
blurb: Guests arrive at the North Las Vegas Airport hangar, receive a full ground briefing, gear up, and then fly in an Extra 330LC aerobatic plane with a veteran pilot. Flights range from ride-alongs to full aerobatic and combat experiences where guests can fly the plane themselves. The experience includes about 3 hours on site, with shuttle service available for guests and spectators.
